description: Source code for the 'PathMatcher' class in the 'yaml' package, implementing YAML node path matching and filtering logic.

classes.name: PathMatcher
classes.description: A class that matches and filters YAML nodes based on specified paths, supporting creation of missing nodes and comment stripping.

methods.name: stripComments
methods.description: Removes comments from nodes if StripComments is enabled.

methods.name: Filter
methods.description: Filters a given RNode based on the path and matching criteria, also stripping comments.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Internal method that performs the core filtering logic based on the path segments.

methods.name: doMatchEvery
methods.description: Matches all elements in a sequence.

methods.name: visitEveryElem
methods.description: Visits each element in a sequence to find matches.

methods.name: doField
methods.description: Handles matching and creation of a specific field in a YAML node.

methods.name: doIndexSeq
methods.description: Handles matching and creation of sequence elements by index.

methods.name: doSeq
methods.description: Handles matching sequence elements based on regex and creation.

methods.name: visitPrimitiveElem
methods.description: Visits sequence elements that are primitives for regex matching.

methods.name: visitElem
methods.description: Visits sequence elements for regex matching on a specific field.

methods.name: appendRNode
methods.description: Appends an RNode to the current sequence.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends nodes to the sequence and records matches.

methods.name: handleStructuredDataInScalar
methods.description: Processes scalar nodes containing structured data (JSON/YAML) for nested path matching.
